string-array.name: changelog_1_3_0_notes
string-array.item: Added French, German, Spanish, Italian and Polish, with language selection.
Added fullscreen map controls and an auto-recenter shortcut.
Added experimental 3D terrain and a hiking theme.
Added support for custom Mapsforge themes sent from the phone.
Improved recording continuity, GPS gap handling and sensor recovery.
Improved offline map downloads and extraction.

string-array.name: changelog_1_2_3_notes
string-array.item: Improved map startup, rendering and navigation performance.
Improved compass behavior after wake and during magnetic interference.
Smoother compass rotation and navigation response.
Preserves map position when returning from the menu.
Improved POI, GPX and recording performance.
Added clearer startup, location and no-active-map feedback.
Added compatibility with older Android 9 and 10 Wear OS watches.

string-array.name: changelog_1_2_2_notes
string-array.item: More reliable compass and turn-by-turn guidance, including after pauses.
Smoother recording and more consistent distance and speed.
Pinch-to-zoom, map long-press actions and clearer route progress.
Better terrain handling and elevation profiles with your location shown.
More reliable watch–phone transfers and map/GPX loading.
Stability and performance improvements.

string-array.name: changelog_1_2_1_notes
string-array.item: Improved battery performance during navigation and recording.
Auto-pause is now enabled by default.
More efficient GPS and compass handling.
Better behavior when the screen is off or the watch is idle.
More reliable track recording, distance and elevation.
Improved GPS recovery and Watch GPS fallback when the phone disconnects.
Improved offline map downloads and extraction recovery.
Improved map zoom, hillshade stability, turn-by-turn navigation and rotary controls.

string-array.name: changelog_1_2_0_notes
string-array.item: Added recording activities.
Added turn-by-turn navigation.
Added support for external sensors, including HR straps and Stryd pods.
Added Hike and Bike activity profiles.
Improved GPS behavior during recording and navigation.
Improved performance and map responsiveness.
Improved battery efficiency, especially during long recordings and navigation sessions.
Improved the UI layout.

string-array.name: changelog_1_1_3_notes
string-array.item: Added creation of recorded activities directly from the watch.
Added creation of turn-by-turn navigation directly from the watch.
Added support for external sensors, including HR straps and Stryd pods.
Added Hike and Bike activity profiles.
Improved GPS behavior during recording and navigation.
Improved performance and map responsiveness.
Improved battery efficiency, especially during long recordings and navigation sessions.
Improved the UI layout.

string-array.name: changelog_1_1_2_notes
string-array.item: Added a GPX track direction arrow option.
Added back button support on compatible watches.
Added adjustable position marker placement.
Redesigned POI icons, settings and navigation.
Added higher-quality elevation data.
Added GPX track export from watch to phone.
Updated download bundles with Refuge.info POIs and improved bundle navigation.
Added quick guides for POI, GPX and Maps, plus battery, stability and performance improvements.

string-array.name: changelog_1_1_0_notes
string-array.item: Fixed the download cancel button and other minor issues.
Added direct download bundles from the watch.
Added a new home screen.
Fixed marker and POI-creation issues and improved overall stability.

string-array.name: changelog_1_0_5_notes
string-array.item: Fixed compass issues on Samsung watches.
Fixed zoom levels on large maps.
Fixed theme cache issues.
Fixed layouts on small screens.
Added the OS Map theme.
Added a shortcut to the night-mode theme.

string-array.name: changelog_1_0_4_notes
string-array.item: Fixed DEM downloads for some areas.
